posts.author: Sergio
posts.content_md:
Great start!

I wonder how blue is your plate before exposure?, the optical density is important for these Denisyuk's, the modulation index of MBDCG is specially high, so the beautiful direct hologram.

The MB will bleach with exposure but i don't know if completely, with a ~10um thickness the setup film is very similar to photopolymers, but here the initial blue colour or optical density coupled with thickness is the more critical before development itself.

The room temperature was about 19 degrees.

Hans and I make last saturday a 'new' batch.

Hans helped me to make a new batch because I hate that chemicals

and with Hans chemicals and coating knowledge it was and looks very easy. Every one can make it if you have good ventilation and a good ph meter.

we measured the coating thickness it was around 10 microns

 It is mold coated the rodcoating machine doesn't work very well the coating is not nice ( air bubbles ) who has a solution? 

The colour of the coating is very transparent blue.

The temperature of the water bath is arond 26 degrees.

Alcohol bath 1 around 40% alcohol

Alcohol bath 2 around 100%

Dry with hot air and you have a beautifull and super bright homemade hologram ( it looks the same as a ultimate hologram ).

posts.author: JohnFP
posts.content_md:
Kris, that is a great hologram. I love the white. I always liked a white holograms instead of a red or green or yellow holograms because I feel it looks more natural. The public is more used to seeing black and white photos instead of black and green photos.

> the rodcoating machine doesn't work very well the coating is not nice ( air bubbles ) who has a solution?

A couple of months ago I was playing around with "evening" out a homemade emulsion that I could see had some ridges and uneven spots. I took a hair dryer and heated the bottom side of the plate (the glass side) while the emulsion was facing up and the plate was horizontal. I watched as the emulsion liquified and all the uneven ridges disappeared. You could possibly try the same. I am not sure if the bubbes would burst, but it may be worth a try. If it is just a few bubbles, then you could heat from the bottom with the hair dryer and then pop the bubbles with a tooth pic.
